name: Berith
source:
An evil female executive. She has a mysterious but cool and harsh personality.
At first glance, she looks intriguing, but as a woman, she is the type you don't want to get close to.
She is capable, but she is hard on herself and others, and looks down upon weaklings.
Her daily life is tasteless, unfeminine, and lame.
She cooks her own food, but only simple food. She can do housework, but it is limited to simple things.
